newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee steady vs spot, dips vs forward dollar.
newsitem.headline: India rupee steady vs spot, dips vs forward dollar.

text.p: The Indian rupee eased mildly against the forward dollar on Thursday but was steady in the spot market at 35.84/85, dealers said.
"There was some paying (of premia to buy forward dollar), primarily for squaring up ahead of the reporting Friday," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Forward premiums across all maturities rose mildly by one paisa from the opening level, dealers said. But demand for forward dollars appeared to have levelled off and the market was stable, one said.

"Some near month paying seen but with the absence of outright dollar buying (by the Reserve Bank of India), premiums still rule soft amid some sporadic profit taking," said a foreign bank in a forex commentary.
